title: 第21章 他有错在先第22章 那艘船要撞上来
lines: 陆溪儿将这些不堪的往事含糊道出，听话听音，不必说全，戴缨一听便明了。
于是低下头，看向等她回答的小儿。
小儿望着她的一对眼珠黑黝黝的，嘴巴微微张起，面上带着紧张和期盼。
一只小手仍抓着她宽大的袖摆。
拒绝的话戴缨有些说不出口，让她对着一个孩子扯谎，又更羞愧，就在她迟疑间，衣袖一松，那只小手放下，眼中的光亮暗下去，整个人象蒙上一层灰影。
她看在眼里，心里有些不落忍，可自己也只是客居于此，哪有能力顾及他人。
思来想去，仍是说道：“崇哥儿，晚些时候可问问你父亲，他若同意了，咱们便一道出府赏玩花灯，如此可好？”
陆崇圆圆的眼睛重新燃起光亮，高高扬起嘴角，嘴角边镶着两个笑窝。
戴缨心里叹着，多好的孩子啊！
小陆崇伸出手，又缩回，最后重新拉起戴缨的衣袖，腔音有些唯诺：“姐姐，你知道我的名字？”
戴缨点头道：“知道，我刚才唤你了。”
小陆崇步调变得轻快，好象再走快些，便能飞起来。
“我去同爹爹说，爹爹一定会让我去的，姐姐出府时不要忘记带上崇儿，若是没看见，就问下人们，好不好？”
戴缨心软得一塌糊涂，应道：“好，若你父亲点头，我便带你出府。”
“那咱们拉勾勾。”
小陆崇伸出小指，戴缨也伸出小指，勾了勾。
陆溪儿在一旁看着，故意逗他：“崇哥儿，你爹爹若是不同意，这勾勾不白拉了？”
小陆崇低下头，再次变得安静，回到先时怏怏不乐的模样。
不管高门还是蓬户，一般这个年纪的孩子，若是有人以唱反调的形式故意逗趣，他们便会以自己小小的气势去反驳，再不济也是嬉笑着回应。
而这孩子的反应不同。
他好象习惯了被压制，习惯别人说什么便是什么，习惯以沉默应对。
上午是游园，宽阔一点的路面以石板铺就，路面光洁平坦，两边是打理过的绿茵席，绿茵之上零星种着几棵不知名的树作为点缀，那树叶绿色居多，间或杂着几簇红叶、黄叶。
小径上铺着型状不规整的灰白石，石缝间留有短茬茬的青笞。
路两旁密密匝匝着半人高的植木，再走一段，转到另一条小径，半人高的植木变为拂裙裾的矮丛。
风中送来潺潺的水声，穿过几座山石，是一片碧清的湖溪，说它是湖因为表面阔大，说它是溪，因为能明显感到水流的漪澜。
湖溪上搭着一座小石桥。
这石桥更象装饰，并不能过人，两三人还罢，他们这主主仆仆的呼啦啦一群，真要走上去，只怕桥体承不住。
两位老夫人走了一会儿，有些累了，坐到亭间休憩，那亭间设有桌案，案上摆了各类水果、茶点。
除了何氏同姚氏两位年轻的媳妇伴在两位老夫人身侧，其他人各自散开，继续游园。
戴缨寻了一处临水的敞亭，倚着栏杆坐下，拿帕拭了拭汗。
“娘子，我让人端些茶、果来。”
归雁说道。
戴缨点了点头。
陆溪儿带着丫头走了来，坐到一边，腔调中带着怨嗔：“当真是恼人。”
“刚才见你还晴着脸，笑呵呵地逗崇哥儿，怎么一转眼就阴了？”
“本是想着晚间咱俩出府，我带你好好转一转京都，现在不能了。”
content_en:
Lu Xi'er vaguely told these unbearable past events, and he listened carefully. It was not necessary to tell the whole story. Dai Ying understood it as soon as he heard it.
So she lowered her head and looked at the child who was waiting for her answer.
The child's eyes were dark as he looked at her, his mouth slightly open, with tension and expectation on his face.
One small hand was still holding the hem of her wide sleeve.
Dai Ying couldn't say the words of rejection, which made her lie to a child and made her even more ashamed. Just as she hesitated, her sleeves loosened, her little hand dropped, the light in her eyes dimmed, and her whole body seemed to be cast into a gray shadow.
Seeing this, she felt a little unbearable, but she was just a guest here, so how could she care about others.
After thinking about it, he still said: "Brother Chong, I can ask your father later. If he agrees, we can go out together to enjoy the lanterns. How about that?"
Lu Chong's round eyes were gleaming again, and he raised the corners of his mouth, with two smiley holes at the corners.
Dai Ying sighed in her heart, what a good child!
Little Lu Chong stretched out his hand, then retracted it, and finally pulled up Dai Ying's sleeve again, with a somewhat submissive tone: "Sister, do you know my name?"
Dai Ying nodded and said, "I know, I called you just now."
Little Lu Chong's pace became brisk, as if he could fly if he walked faster.
"I'm going to tell dad that he will definitely let me go. Don't forget to take Chong'er with you when my sister leaves the house. If you don't see her, just ask people, okay?"
Dai Ying was so soft-hearted that she responded: "Okay, if your father nods, I will take you out of the house."
"Then let's pull Gou Gou."
Xiao Lu Chong stretched out his little finger, and Dai Ying also stretched out his little finger and made a hook.
Lu Xi'er watched from the side and deliberately teased him: "Brother Chong, if your father doesn't agree, is this going to be in vain?"
Xiao Lu Chong lowered his head and became quiet again, returning to his previous unhappy appearance.
Regardless of whether they are from a high-ranking family or from a poor family, generally children of this age, if someone deliberately teases someone by playing devil's advocate, they will refute with their own little momentum, and even if it doesn't work, they will respond with a smile.
But this kid reacted differently.
He seems to be used to being suppressed, used to being told what others say, and used to responding with silence.
In the morning we visited the garden. The road was paved with stone slabs. The road was smooth and flat, with green mats on both sides. There were a few unknown trees planted on the green mats as decorations. The leaves were mostly green, with a few clusters of red and yellow leaves scattered here and there.
The path is paved with irregular-shaped gray and white stones, with short green stubbles left in the gaps between the stones.
On both sides of the road, there are densely planted trees half a man tall. After walking a little further, you turn to another path, and the half-man tall trees turn into skirt-skirted bushes.
The wind brought the sound of gurgling water, passing through several rocks, and there was a clear lake and stream. It was called a lake because its surface was wide, and it was called a stream because the ripples of the water could be clearly felt.
There is a small stone bridge across the lake and stream.
This stone bridge is more like a decoration and cannot be used for passing people. It is enough for two or three people. They are a group of masters and servants. If they really want to walk up, I am afraid that the bridge body cannot bear it.
The two old ladies walked for a while, feeling a little tired, and sat down to rest in the pavilion. There was a table in the pavilion with various fruits and refreshments on it.
Except for the two young daughters-in-law of Mr. He and Mr. Yao, who were by the two old ladies' sides, everyone else dispersed and continued to visit the garden.
Dai Ying found an open pavilion near the water, sat down leaning on the railing, and wiped his sweat with a handkerchief.
"Madam, I'll ask someone to bring you some tea and fruit."
Gui Yan said.
Dai Ying nodded.
Lu Xi'er came over with the girl, sat aside, and said with resentment in her tone: "It's really annoying."
"I just saw you smiling and teasing Brother Chong with a clear face. How come you turned sour in the blink of an eye?"
"I originally thought that we would go out in the evening and I would take you around Kyoto, but I can't do that now."
